ble_219_0c037a7c.name: ble_analog_bank1_user_mask_update
ble_219_0c037a7c.summary: Set or clear one user bit in the bank-1 analog enable mask and reprogram 0x1052/0x1053
ble_219_0c037a7c.description: Maintains DAT_20003CD8, a bitmask of users of the bank-1 analog block: a non-zero param_2 ORs param_1 in, zero ANDs it out. Registers 0x1052 and 0x1053 are only touched on a transition, when the mask goes from zero to non-zero (enable) or becomes zero (disable). Enable writes 0x1052 with bits 7:4 cleared and bit 0 set, waits 10 us with hal_sys_timer_delay_us, rewrites 0x1052 with bits 7:4 restored, waits 5 us and then sets bit 0 of 0x1053. Disable clears bit 0 of 0x1052, waits 5 us and clears bit 0 of 0x1053. The register updates run in a BASEPRI 0x40 section that records the lock owner in DAT_20003D70/DAT_20003D74.

params.name: param_1
params.description: user bit(s) to add or remove in DAT_20003CD8

params.name: param_2
params.description: non-zero sets the user bits, zero clears them

ble_219_0c037a7c.notes: Function of registers 0x1052/0x1053 not identified. The mask behaves as a reference count of users.

ble_219_0c037b58.name: ble_rf_synth_retune
ble_219_0c037b58.summary: Retune the RF synthesiser mode and ratio for frequency pair (param_1 x param_2), with a cache
ble_219_0c037b58.description: Selects an RF operating mode from the product p = param_1 * param_2 and writes it to the 4-bit field of 0x136A: 0x0EA60000 gives 5, 0x11940000 gives 3, 0x14820000 gives 1 and other products give 0. The product 0x0A410000 is a special case that uses mode 10 and clears bit 7 of 0x1367 instead of setting it, with 0x6448/0x7744 in place of 0x6548/0x7745 in registers 0x1371/0x1372. It then loads the synthesiser ratio ((p << 28) + ref/2) / ref, where ref is the measured reference clock from ble_ram_patch_thunk_2000022c, through ble_rf_synth_ratio_write, and sets the 5-bit field of 0x3170 from param_2 with ble_rf_reg3170_field_set. A two-entry cache keyed by (param_1, param_2) in DAT_20003CB8..DAT_20003CD4 (active slot DAT_20003CE0) returns early when the same pair is already active.

params.name: param_1
params.description: first frequency factor; product with param_2 is the target (probably in Hz)

params.name: param_2
params.description: second factor; also written as a 5-bit field into 0x3170

ble_219_0c037b58.notes: Meaning of the mode values and of registers 0x1367/0x136A/0x1371/0x1372 not identified. The 0x0A410000 case is the odd one out.

ble_219_0c037f88.name: ble_analog_chan_group_mask_apply
ble_219_0c037f88.summary: OR a channel's two stored masks into its bank-4 analog config register (0x4040..0x4066)
ble_219_0c037f88.description: Maps channel index param_1 to one of six bank-4 analog configuration registers: 1 or 2 to 0x4040, 5 or 6 to 0x4060, 7 to 10 to 0x4063, 11 to 0x4064, 16 to 0x4066 and every other index to 0x4065. It reads that register with hal_analogif_reg_read, ORs in the 16-bit words at DAT_20003C2A + 8*index and DAT_20003C2C + 8*index, and writes it back with hal_analogif_reg_write, so this routine only ever sets bits. When DAT_20003D64 equals 2 (hardware variant, see bes_otp_load_variant) it spins in an infinite loop instead.
ble_219_0c037f88.notes: The two-word per-index record at 0x20003C2A is not identified.

ble_219_0c038128.name: ble_analog_status_dispatch
ble_219_0c038128.summary: Dispatch the bank-4 analog status words 0x4080/0x4081 to channel mask writes and a callback
ble_219_0c038128.description: Interrupt-side dispatcher for the analog status registers. It reads 0x4080 and 0x4081 and builds a cause word from bits 1..11 of 0x4080 and bits 0..4 of 0x4081 (moved to bits 12..16). It walks a 13-entry table at ROM 0x0C081C48 with 8-byte entries (a 32-bit mask and a channel index byte) and, for each entry whose mask intersects the cause, ORs that channel's mask (DAT_20003C28 + 8*index) into the analog register chosen by the index, as in ble_analog_chan_group_mask_apply. If bit 1 of 0x4080 is set the first entry is processed regardless of its mask. Finally it calls the optional callback DAT_20003C24 with the cause word, and the status reads run in a BASEPRI 0x40 section with the lock trace.
ble_219_0c038128.notes: Table decoding (entry stride and index byte position) is inferred from decompiled offsets. Caller not identified.

ble_219_0c0384e8.name: ble_analog_cal_0x4059_trigger
ble_219_0c0384e8.summary: Set the 0x4059 low nibble to 9, or pulse 0x405A bit 1 for 100 settle cycles, by sticky flag
ble_219_0c0384e8.description: Under the BASEPRI 0x40 lock trace, if the sticky flag DAT_20003D65 is 1 it replaces the low nibble of register 0x4059 with 9. Otherwise it sets bit 1 of register 0x405A and writes that value 100 times, each write followed by a 5-unit settle (thunk 0x20000570 arms the delay, thunk 0x20000334 waits). A variant-2 part (DAT_20003D64 == 2) halts in an infinite loop before doing any of this.
ble_219_0c0384e8.notes: Purpose of 0x4059/0x405A and of the sticky flag DAT_20003D65 not identified. The 5-unit delay is assumed to be microseconds.

ble_219_0c038654.name: ble_analog_cal_0x4059_ramp
ble_219_0c038654.summary: Ramp the 0x4059 low nibble up to 0xE in single steps, then write 7 to 0x4024
ble_219_0c038654.description: If the sticky flag DAT_20003D65 is not 1, it writes 7 to register 0x4024 when DAT_20003D64 is below 2 and returns. With the flag set it reads 0x4059 and, when its low nibble is below 14, writes each value from nibble+1 up to 0xE, one write per step, keeping the other bits. It then waits 10 units through thunk 0x20000348 and writes 0x4024 = 7 again under the same variant condition. This is the counterpart of ble_analog_cal_0x4059_trigger.
ble_219_0c038654.notes: Purpose of the ramp is not identified.

ble_219_0c0386e0.name: ble_reg3008_nibble_floor
ble_219_0c0386e0.summary: Raise the low nibble of register 0x3008 to a floor of 4, or 6 when DAT_20003D6A bits 4/6 are set
ble_219_0c0386e0.description: Computes a floor of 6 when DAT_20003D6A has bit 4 or bit 6 set, and 4 otherwise. It then reads register 0x3008 and, if its low nibble is below the floor, writes the floor into the low nibble and keeps the upper bits. The leading test on the shifted flags byte is only true for a value wider than 8 bits, so for this byte it always takes the else branches.
ble_219_0c0386e0.notes: Purpose of the 0x3008 low nibble is not identified. The dead first test is also present in ble_219_0c039364.

ble_219_0c038730.name: ble_rf_event_status_isr
ble_219_0c038730.summary: RF/analog interrupt handler: acknowledge 0x305E, 0x3051, 0x3048 and call up to six callbacks
ble_219_0c038730.description: Interrupt handler installed at vector 58 by ble_rf_event_source_enable (the constant 0x0C038731 is written to VTOR+0xE8). Inside a BASEPRI 0x40 section it reads the RF status registers 0x305E, 0x3051 and 0x3048 in turn and writes each one back when its active bits are set, which acknowledges write-1-to-clear latches (assumed). It then calls, with the register value, every non-null callback in the slot table at DAT_2000BCE8..DAT_2000BCFC: 0x305E bits 3..4 go to DAT_2000BCF0 and bits 14..15 to DAT_2000BCFC; 0x3051 bits 0..12 to DAT_2000BCE8 and bits 13..14 to DAT_2000BCEC; 0x3048 bit 11 to DAT_2000BCF8 and bits 14..15 to DAT_2000BCF4.
ble_219_0c038730.notes: Write-back acknowledge assumed to be write-1-to-clear. The slot table is shared with ble_rf_event_source_enable.

ble_219_0c0388b0.name: ble_rf_event_source_enable
ble_219_0c0388b0.summary: Install or remove the handler for RF event source 0..4 and manage NVIC IRQ 42
ble_219_0c0388b0.description: Stores param_2 (a handler pointer, zero to disable) in slot DAT_2000BCE8 + 4*param_1 and sets or clears the source's enable bits in 0x3040 (sources 0..2 use bits 13, 14 and 12) or 0x3041 (source 3 uses bits 12..13, source 4 uses bit 11). When it is the first source to be enabled it writes 0x0C038731 (ble_rf_event_status_isr) into vector 58 at VTOR+0xE8, sets priority byte 0xA0 at 0xE000E42A, clears pending in ICPR1 (0xE000E284) and enables bit 0x400 in ISER1 (0xE000E104). When the last enabled source is removed it clears the same bit in ICER1 (0xE000E184). Returns 0.

params.name: param_2
params.description: handler pointer; zero disables the source

ble_219_0c0388b0.notes: 0x400 in ISER1 is IRQ 42, consistent with vector 58 and IPR 0xE42A. The slot table is also read by ble_rf_event_status_isr.

ble_219_0c038bcc.name: ble_rf_agc_window_update_a
ble_219_0c038bcc.summary: Recompute AGC window A: clamped level from param_1 + DAT_2000BCE1 and bound from DAT_2000BCE0
ble_219_0c038bcc.description: Computes a saturated 8-bit value v = clamp(param_1 + DAT_2000BCE1, 0, 255) and a lower bound b = max(0, DAT_2000BCE0 + 4). It writes b into the low byte and v into the high byte of register 0x3013, and writes v into the low byte of 0x30D2, each as a read-modify-write. Bit 0x10 of DAT_2000BCD0 is set when b is below v and cleared otherwise.
ble_219_0c038bcc.notes: The AGC interpretation is a guess from the register and flag pattern. Names are provisional. Windows B and C are the sibling routines.

ble_219_0c038c58.name: ble_rf_agc_window_update_b
ble_219_0c038c58.summary: Recompute AGC window B: clamped level from param_1 + DAT_2000BCE3 and bound from DAT_2000BCE7
ble_219_0c038c58.description: Computes v = clamp(param_1 + DAT_2000BCE3, 0, 255) and b = max(0, DAT_2000BCE7 + 0x26). It writes v into the low byte and b into the high byte of register 0x30C3, and b into the low byte of 0x30D3, leaving the other bits alone. Bit 0x04 of DAT_2000BCD0 is set when b is below v and cleared otherwise.
ble_219_0c038c58.notes: Provisional AGC name, as for window A.

ble_219_0c038ce0.name: ble_rf_agc_window_update_c
ble_219_0c038ce0.summary: Recompute AGC window C: clamped level from param_1 + DAT_2000BCE2 and bound from DAT_2000BCE6
ble_219_0c038ce0.description: Computes v = clamp(param_1 + DAT_2000BCE2, 0, 255) and b = max(0, DAT_2000BCE6 + 6). It writes b into the low byte and v into the high byte of register 0x304A, and writes v into the high byte of 0x30D2 while keeping its low byte. Bit 0x08 of DAT_2000BCD0 is set when b is below v and cleared otherwise.
ble_219_0c038ce0.notes: Provisional AGC name, as for window A. This routine is also called from ble_rf_power_ramp_step.

ble_219_0c038d68.name: ble_chip_variant_probe
ble_219_0c038d68.summary: Read the chip variant from OTP and return the high half of SYSREG 0x40080000
ble_219_0c038d68.description: Performs a read of register 0x3000 whose result is discarded, then loads the hardware variant into DAT_20003D64 with bes_otp_load_variant and returns the upper 16 bits of peripheral register 0x40080000 from bes_sysreg_read_80000_hi16. It is called from ble_219_0c02ed2c during early chip initialisation.
ble_219_0c038d68.notes: Purpose of the discarded 0x3000 read is unclear; it may be a settle or wake read.

ble_219_0c038d8c.name: ble_rf_synth_load_ratio48
ble_219_0c038d8c.summary: Write a 48-bit synthesiser ratio to 0x2148..0x214A, latch it in 0x214C and wait for settle
ble_219_0c038d8c.description: Writes param_1, param_2 and param_3 as the three 16-bit words of a 48-bit divider ratio to registers 0x2148, 0x2149 and 0x214A with hal_analogif_reg_write, stopping at the first failure. If all three writes succeed it sets bit 0 of 0x214C as a read-modify-write, and if that succeeds too it arms a 100-unit delay through thunk 0x200005A8 and waits on thunk 0x20000334. Callers are ble_rf_synth_set_freq_ratio and ble_analog_chip_init.

params.name: param_3
params.description: ratio bits 47..32, low 3 bits used (goes to 0x214A)

ble_219_0c038d8c.notes: Mapping of 0x2148..0x214C to synthesiser fields is inferred from the call pattern.

ble_219_0c038df8.name: ble_rf_synth_set_freq_ratio
ble_219_0c038df8.summary: Compute the Q28 synthesiser ratio param_1 / reference clock and load it
ble_219_0c038df8.description: Reads the reference clock through ble_ram_patch_thunk_2000022c and computes the rounded 64-bit quotient (param_1 << 28 + ref/2) / ref, which is the target-to-reference ratio in Q28 fixed point. The 48-bit quotient is split into three 16-bit words (bits 0..15, 16..31 and 32..47) and handed to ble_rf_synth_load_ratio48. A zero reference makes __udivdi3 return all ones.

params.name: param_1
params.description: target frequency, in the same unit as the reference clock

ble_219_0c038e24.name: ble_rf_synth_ratio_write
ble_219_0c038e24.summary: Write the low 32 ratio bits to 0x2148/0x2149, bits 34..32 to 0x214A, then set latch 0x214C bit 0
ble_219_0c038e24.description: Unchecked, low-level sibling of ble_rf_synth_load_ratio48. It writes the low 16 bits of param_1 to 0x2148 and the high 16 bits to 0x2149, merges the low three bits of param_2 into bits 2:0 of 0x214A, and sets bit 0 of 0x214C. The call sites also pass a constant 1 that this routine never reads. Called from ble_rf_synth_retune.

ble_219_0c038e8c.name: ble_rf_reg3170_field_set
ble_219_0c038e8c.summary: Set the 5-bit field in bits 6:2 of analog register 0x3170
ble_219_0c038e8c.description: Reads register 0x3170, replaces bits 6..2 with param_1 & 0x1F and writes the register back with hal_analogif_reg_write, leaving every other bit unchanged. ble_rf_synth_retune uses it to set the field from its second argument.
ble_219_0c038e8c.notes: Meaning of the field is not identified.

ble_219_0c039034.name: ble_rf_reg3005_303f_clear
ble_219_0c039034.summary: Clear bit 8 of analog register 0x3005 and bit 15 of register 0x303F
ble_219_0c039034.description: Under the BASEPRI 0x40 lock trace it clears bit 8 of register 0x3005, then clears bit 15 of register 0x303F by keeping only bits 0..14, each as a read-modify-write. It has no set counterpart in this packet, so it is probably a disable or power-down step. Callers are ble_219_0c039820 and ble_219_0c03a2a0.
ble_219_0c039034.notes: The two bits are not identified. Its three arguments are unused.

ble_219_0c0390a8.name: ble_rf_chan_ctrl_update
ble_219_0c0390a8.summary: Apply table-driven set/clear operations to the control register of channel index 0..4
ble_219_0c0390a8.description: Selects the analog register for index param_1 (0 and 1 give 0x3007 and 0x3008, 2 gives 0x30DD, 3 gives 0x300E, 4 gives 0x3069) and applies table-driven set or clear operations from an 18-byte row per index at ROM 0x0C0836A8. Flags param_2 and param_3 set or clear the row's first and second masks, param_4 chooses one of two mutually exclusive mask pairs, and param_5 sets or clears a third mask. The register is written once at the end.

params.name: param_2
params.description: flag: set (non-zero) or clear the first mask

params.name: param_3
params.description: flag: set or clear the second mask

params.name: param_4
params.description: mode: selects one of two mask pairs

params.name: param_5
params.description: flag: set or clear the third mask

ble_219_0c0390a8.notes: Table contents and per-bit meanings are not identified. Callers are ble_219_0c039488, ble_219_0c039820, ble_219_0c03a204, ble_219_0c03a244 and ble_219_0c03a2a0.

ble_219_0c039190.name: ble_rf_chan_field_write
ble_219_0c039190.summary: Insert two values into the channel bit-fields of index param_1 (index 2 uses 0x30DD/0x30DE)
ble_219_0c039190.description: For index 2 it replaces the low 6 bits of 0x30DD with param_3 and of 0x30DE with param_2. For other indices it selects the register (3 gives 0x300E, 4 gives 0x3069 with both values clamped to 10, others 0x3007/0x3008) and inserts param_2 and param_3 into the masked, shifted fields given by the 18-byte row at ROM 0x0C0836B2 + 18*index. The merge is x ^ ((v << s ^ x) & m), so bits outside the mask survive. It is the write half of ble_rf_chan_field_read.

ble_219_0c039264.name: ble_rf_chan_field_read
ble_219_0c039264.summary: Read the two channel bit-fields of index param_1 that ble_rf_chan_field_write writes
ble_219_0c039264.description: Read counterpart of ble_rf_chan_field_write. For index 2 it stores the low 6 bits of 0x30DE into *param_2 and of 0x30DD into *param_3. For other indices it reads the selected register and extracts field A (mask and shift from the ROM row at 0x0C0836B2) into *param_2 and field B (0x0C0836B6 and B8) into *param_3. Either output pointer may be null, in which case it is skipped, and the function always returns 0.

ble_219_0c039308.name: ble_rf_chan_field_set_ramped
ble_219_0c039308.summary: Set channel fields to (param_2, param_3), stepping the second field up one unit at a time
ble_219_0c039308.description: Reads the current fields of index param_1 with ble_rf_chan_field_read. If the current second field is below the target param_3 it steps that field up one unit per iteration, calling ble_rf_chan_field_write each time. Otherwise, if either field differs from its target, it writes both fields at once, and when both already match it writes nothing. Callers are ble_219_0c039364 and ble_219_0c03a204.
ble_219_0c039308.notes: The stepping loop calls ble_rf_chan_field_write with two arguments in the decompiled code, so the value written per step is uncertain.

ble_219_0c039364.name: ble_rf_power_ramp_step
ble_219_0c039364.summary: Step a channel level ramp toward threshold 24 or 38 and settle the group-1 fields
ble_219_0c039364.description: Runs under the BASEPRI 0x40 lock trace. A group of 0 defaults to DAT_2000354C. The threshold is 24 with count 4 unless DAT_20003D6A has bit 4 or bit 6 set, when it is 38 with count 6. Group 3 takes its level from the high byte of register 0x304A minus DAT_2000BCE2, raises it toward the threshold with ble_rf_agc_window_update_c, and then writes group-1 fields (1, 1, count) with ble_rf_chan_field_set_ramped. Other groups do the same field write and window update, with a 10-unit delay through thunk 0x20000348 on the paths where the level has to move.

params.name: param_1
params.description: group index; 0 means DAT_2000354C, 3 selects the level path

ble_219_0c039364.notes: Purpose of the ramp, the constants 24/38 and the group numbering are not identified.

ble_219_0c039828.name: ble_rf_block_gate_301d_30ce
ble_219_0c039828.summary: Set or clear bit 15 of register 0x301D together with bit 7 of register 0x30CE
ble_219_0c039828.description: With a non-zero param_1 it sets bit 15 of 0x301D and bit 7 of 0x30CE. With zero it clears bit 15 of 0x301D (by keeping the low 15 bits) and bit 7 of 0x30CE. Each register is a read-modify-write, with no lock trace. The caller is ble_219_0c03a2a0.

params.name: param_1
params.description: flag: non-zero enables the gate, zero disables it

ble_219_0c0398ac.name: ble_rf_lut_index_write
ble_219_0c0398ac.summary: Write a 6-bit index derived from param_2 into 0x3029 and/or 0x302A bits 10:5, as flagged in param_1
ble_219_0c0398ac.description: Derives a 6-bit index from param_2: 19 for values up to 1600, otherwise 19 + (param_2 - 1600) / 40, saturated at 48. It writes 0x3029 with bits 1..4 cleared and bits 2 and 4 set. It then writes the index into bits 10..5 of 0x3029 when bit 18 of param_1 is set and into bits 10..5 of 0x302A when bit 19 is set. The third and fourth arguments are not read by the code.
ble_219_0c0398ac.notes: Meaning of the 1600 threshold and the 40-unit step is not identified.

ble_219_0c0399b4.name: ble_rf_osc_trim_calibrate
ble_219_0c0399b4.summary: Sweep the 0x216E[11:9] trim code against a 50 ms clock count and keep the centre of the best run
ble_219_0c0399b4.description: Retunes the synthesiser with ble_rf_synth_retune(param_1, param_2), switches the system clock configuration to 4 (and to 7 during each measurement), and sweeps the 3-bit trim field in register 0x216E bits 11..9 over codes 0..7. Each code is measured with bes_clk_measure_hz(50) and accepted when the count lies between target - 1.6*tol and target + 1.2*tol, where target = param_1*param_2/8 and tol is derived from the two reference rates. The code written back is the centre of the longest run of accepted codes, and the saved clock configuration is restored afterwards.
ble_219_0c0399b4.notes: The meaning of the trim field and the window factors 1.6 and 1.2 are taken from the code.

ble_219_0c039c30.name: ble_rf_ch24_25_mode_bits_set
ble_219_0c039c30.summary: Set the 2-bit mode field (bits 9:8) of the register for channel 0x24 or 0x25
ble_219_0c039c30.description: Only channels 0x24 and 0x25 are handled, and any other index returns at once. The register is 0x302B for 0x24 and 0x303E for 0x25, updated under the BASEPRI 0x40 lock trace. Bits 9:8 become 0x200 for param_2 == 0, 0x100 for param_2 == 1 and 0 for other values. It is a sibling of ble_rf_ch24_25_sel_bits_set, which uses bits 10 and 12 of the same registers.

ble_219_0c039c40.name: ble_rf_ch24_25_sel_bits_set
ble_219_0c039c40.summary: Select one route (bit 10 or bit 12) in the register of channel 0x24 or 0x25
ble_219_0c039c40.description: Only channels 0x24 and 0x25 are handled. The registers are 0x302B (0x24) and 0x303E (0x25), updated under the BASEPRI 0x40 lock trace. Bits 10 and 12 are cleared, then bit 10 is set when param_2 == 1 or bit 12 when param_2 == 2, so 0 and other values leave both clear. It is a sibling of ble_rf_ch24_25_mode_bits_set.

params.name: param_2
params.description: route select: 1 sets bit 10, 2 sets bit 12

ble_219_0c039cf4.name: ble_rf_ch_status_flag_get
ble_219_0c039cf4.summary: Return whether bit 13 (channel 0x24) or bit 12 (other channels) of register 0x3048 is set
ble_219_0c039cf4.description: Reads register 0x3048 and returns true when the bit for the channel is set: 0x2000 for channel 0x24 and 0x1000 for any other index. It does not clear the bit and takes no lock.

returns.description: true when the status bit is set

ble_219_0c039cf4.notes: The meaning of the status bits is not identified.

ble_219_0c039d24.name: ble_rf_ch_route_select
ble_219_0c039d24.summary: Select the routing bits of 0x3046/0x3047 for channel 0x24 or for other channels
ble_219_0c039d24.description: For channel 0x24, bit 15 of 0x3046 is set, bits 2 and 5 of 0x3046 are cleared and bit 5 of 0x3047 is set. For any other channel, bit 15 of 0x3046 is cleared, bit 5 of 0x3046 is set and bits 2 and 5 of 0x3047 are cleared. Each register is a read-modify-write, and ble_rf_ch_route_select_alt writes the complementary pattern.

params.name: param_1
params.description: channel index; 0x24 selects the first pattern

ble_219_0c039dc0.name: ble_rf_ch_route_select_alt
ble_219_0c039dc0.summary: Select the complementary routing bits of 0x3046/0x3047 for channel 0x24 or other channels
ble_219_0c039dc0.description: For channel 0x24, bits 2 and 5 of 0x3046 are set, bit 15 of 0x3046 is cleared and bit 5 of 0x3047 is cleared. For any other channel, bit 15 of 0x3046 is set, bit 5 of 0x3046 is cleared and bits 2 and 5 of 0x3047 are set. This is the complementary pattern of ble_rf_ch_route_select, and each register is a read-modify-write.

params.name: param_1
params.description: channel index; 0x24 selects the first pattern

ble_219_0c03a038.name: ble_analog_chip_init
ble_219_0c03a038.summary: Boot-time analog and RF bring-up: read variant and OTP, unlock ISPI, program defaults, retune
ble_219_0c03a038.description: Boot-time analog and RF bring-up. It first runs ble_analog_cal_0x4059_ramp, then sets DAT_20003D6C to 2 if bit 0 of the saved status nibble (hal_pmu_get_saved_status_nibble) is set, to 4 if only bit 1 is set, and otherwise to the bits 1..3 of register 0x305F mapped to 1, 0x20, 8, 0x10 or 0. It sets DAT_20003D6D when bit 0 of register 0x3061 is clear, caches register 0x305E in DAT_20003D68, and stores a boot record with bes_boot_flag_set unless bes_boot_magic_get returns 0x4F42494D. It reads OTP field 1 through thunk 0x2000067C, checks it with thunk 0x2000065C, and selects a ROM configuration word with hal_chip_select_cfg_word from its top two bits (0 on a failed check). It halts if ble_219_0c040378 returns non-zero, then unlocks the analog ISPI by writing 0xCAFE and 0x5FEE to 0x3000, 0x2000 and 0x1000 with 500-unit settle delays between them. If the measured reference clock differs from the nominal 24 MHz it reloads the synthesiser ratio through ble_rf_synth_load_ratio48, and finally it writes defaults to 0x2159, 0x215A, 0x215B and 0x216E (trim code 4) and clears bits 3..5 of 0x2146.
